mapper.select: SELECT daily_statistics.statistics_date AS date, daily_statistics.total_order_count, daily_statistics.completed_order_count, daily_statistics.canceled_order_count, daily_statistics.total_sales_amount FROM daily_statistics WHERE daily_statistics.statistics_date >= #{startDate} AND daily_statistics.statistics_date <= #{endDate} ORDER BY daily_statistics.statistics_date

WITH backfill_start AS ( SELECT MIN(statistics_batch_run.target_start_date) AS start_date FROM statistics_batch_runs AS statistics_batch_run WHERE statistics_batch_run.batch_type = 'BACKFILL' ), numbered_statistics AS ( SELECT daily_statistics.statistics_date, backfill_start.start_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY daily_statistics.statistics_date ) AS sequence_number FROM daily_statistics JOIN backfill_start ON backfill_start.start_date IS NOT NULL WHERE daily_statistics.statistics_date >= backfill_start.start_date AND daily_statistics.statistics_date <= #{latestStatisticsDate} ) SELECT MAX(numbered_statistics.statistics_date) FROM numbered_statistics WHERE DATEDIFF( numbered_statistics.statistics_date, numbered_statistics.start_date ) = numbered_statistics.sequence_number - 1
